summary: Corrected the parent configuration question's now-stale account and closed out the divergence attempt. The parent's recorded limitation still claimed that a voter-adding change a stale configuration would miscount was unwitnessed and that multi-voter election consequences were only argued from the code; the child multi-voter question has since established exactly those with four complete comparisons and controls. The parent interpretation is resubmitted with the same experiment, receipts and witness (empty rebuilt configuration at latest index 0 with hasVote false while commit 11 and lastApplied 11 were restored, control keeping index 1 with one voter; snapshot-present case at index 1 with one server against the log's index 1227 with two), a revised limitation list that routes the multi-voter variant to the child evidence, and joint history naming the child receipts 75c355f2/b15f4b6c-citing b15f4b6c55b44402ace926204de9b826 and f0db8b71047e42df96d3e2f4f581835c only for the named follow-on consequence. On the remaining gap point, the third divergence-probe attempt did not land: the harness patch failed to apply and the applied-slice measurement had already not lined up with the conflict index, so entry-level divergence and lost acknowledged entries stay unwitnessed, explicitly recorded as a limitation rather than claimed, with the gap left open (resolved=false).
